plausibility_notes: Every character now has a specific conflict and a lesser concealment; this broadens credible motives without identifying poison access.
Dada and Paige's threats are now explained as intimidation rather than admissions. Artie's alternate employment weakens his financial motive.
No accusation is justified yet. Twenty-two parallel blackmail/confession speeches feel deliberately balanced and somewhat repetitive, though voices have individual details.
